title: 第一卷 第11章 你在狗叫第一卷 第12章 土鸡瓦狗
lines: 秦玄冷漠转头，看向柳家门口。
只见赵龙腾一身蓝衣，大步走来。
在他身后跟着两人，其中一个老者应当是他的侍从。
至于另一个中年人则是火风城城主元昊。
这位城主之前一直被秦家压制，所以和秦家的关系并不好。
现和这位赵家少主一起进来，只怕和赵家已经攀上了关系。
看到秦玄竟然敢无视他，赵龙腾不满的冷笑一声。
随后大摇大摆直接坐到了主位上，神情倨傲地看向秦玄。
“放肆，竟然敢对少主无礼！”
看到秦玄如此质问，那老者立即就要发怒，不过一旁的赵龙腾摆了摆手。
“我是赵家少主赵龙腾，看在你是初犯，我可以再给你一次机会！”
赵龙腾戏谑地看向秦玄。
“现在跪下，臣服于我，从此之后，成为我赵龙腾的奴仆，我可以给你一条生路！”
“否则，死！”
这些话只不过是戏耍秦玄罢了，他根本就没有给秦玄一条生路的打算！
一旁的柳依依扶起柳生，眼神凶戾地盯着秦玄。
“龙腾少主，这个秦玄竟然敢伤我爹，请您一定要替我们柳家主持公道。”
说着，柳依依便楚楚可怜地看向赵龙腾。
这般梨花带雨，我见犹怜的样子确实是让赵龙腾心中大动。
“依依小姐你放心，我一定会给你们柳家讨回公道......”
话音未落，秦玄冷哼一声。
“哪里来的狗在叫？”
“谁的裤子没扎进，把你给露出来了？”
秦玄不屑的说着。
听着这话，赵龙腾的脸色顿时大变。
这么多年了，作为赵家九脉之一的少主，这么多年来，他可以说是顺我者昌逆我者亡。
从来都没有人敢忤逆他。
可是一个小小的火风城秦家少族长竟然敢这么挑衅他！
“你好大的胆子，竟然敢骂本少主！”
赵龙腾站起身来，愤怒地指着秦玄。
“石砸狗叫，你这么激动干嘛？”
“看来你自己也清楚，不然我一说你怎么知道说的是你？”
秦玄冷冷说着。
听着这话，赵龙腾的脸色顿时一阵铁青。
content_en:
"You are..."
Qin Xuan turned his head indifferently and looked at the door of Liu's house.
I saw Zhao Longteng, dressed in blue, striding towards him.
There were two people behind him, one of whom was an old man who should be his attendant.
As for the other middle-aged man, it was Yuan Hao, the lord of Fire Wind City.
This city lord has been suppressed by the Qin family before, so his relationship with the Qin family is not good.
Now that he comes in with the young master of the Zhao family, he is afraid that he has already established a relationship with the Zhao family.
Seeing that Qin Xuan dared to ignore him, Zhao Longteng sneered dissatisfied.
Then he swaggered and sat directly on the main seat, looking at Qin Xuan with an arrogant expression.
"How dare you be rude to the young master!"
Seeing Qin Xuan questioning him like this, the old man was about to get angry, but Zhao Longteng on the side waved his hand.
"I am Zhao Longteng, the young master of the Zhao family. Since you are a first-time offender, I can give you another chance!"
Zhao Longteng looked at Qin Xuan teasingly.
"Kneel down now and surrender to me. From now on, you will become my slave, Zhao Longteng. I can give you a way out!"
"Otherwise, die!"
These words were just teasing Qin Xuan, he had no intention of giving Qin Xuan a way out!
Liu Yiyi on the side helped Liu Sheng up and stared at Qin Xuan with fierce eyes.
"Young Master Longteng, this Qin Xuan dares to hurt my father. Please be sure to uphold justice for our Liu family."
After saying that, Liu Yiyi looked at Zhao Longteng pitifully.
Zhao Longteng's heart was moved by the pitiful look on his face.
"Don't worry, Miss Yiyi, I will definitely seek justice for your Liu family..."
Before he finished speaking, Qin Xuan snorted coldly.
"Where is the barking dog coming from?"
"Whose pants are not tucked in and you are exposed?"
Qin Xuan said disdainfully.
Hearing these words, Zhao Longteng's expression suddenly changed.
After so many years, as the young master of one of the nine branches of the Zhao family, it can be said that those who follow me prosper and those who go against me perish.
No one ever dared to disobey him.
But the young patriarch of the Qin family in Fire Wind City dared to provoke him like this!
"You are so brave, you dare to scold me!"
Zhao Longteng stood up and pointed at Qin Xuan angrily.
"Why are you so excited?"
"It seems you know it yourself, otherwise how would you know I was talking about you when I said it?"
Qin Xuan said coldly.
Hearing these words, Zhao Longteng's face suddenly turned pale.
